query: How do I make quick microwave chocolate pudding?

goal.title: Make quick microwave chocolate pudding
goal.description: Retrieve a dark mixing bowl from an upper cabinet and carry it to a counter already stocked with cocoa powder, milk, a dish towel and a measuring spoon. Tear open the cocoa box, stir cocoa powder and a second dry ingredient into the bowl, then add milk in two additions while stirring until the batter is smooth. Carry the bowl to the microwave, cook it for roughly a minute and a half, then bring it back to the counter and stir the heated mixture until it thickens into a finished chocolate pudding.
goal.final_state: A smooth brown chocolate pudding sits mixed in the dark bowl at the counter; it has not been plated, tasted, or put away by the end of the video.
procedure: Retrieve a bowl and bring it to the ingredients on the counter.
Open the cocoa package and add cocoa and the visible pale dry ingredient to the bowl.
Add milk and stir, adding more milk while mixing.
Carry the mixture to the microwave and heat it.
Remove the bowl and stir the heated brown mixture at the counter.

phases.description: Retrieve the mixing bowl from the cabinet and arrange it with the ingredients on the counter.
Open the cocoa box and mix cocoa powder, a second dry ingredient and milk into a batter.
Continue stirring the batter, then carry it to the microwave and start cooking.
Wait for the microwave to finish cooking the pudding.
Remove the pudding from the microwave and stir it smooth at the counter.

notes: Dense 3-8fps contact sheets and a sparse long-step sheet reviewed for all 26 fine steps plus two full-video overview sheets. Steps 8-9 (t=26.5-31.6s) show a white cup pouring a pale granular ingredient into the bowl; it could not be visually confirmed as a second dose of cocoa powder versus sugar or another dry ingredient, so it is recorded as cocoa powder with ambiguous=true/confidence=low rather than guessed. Step 15 (53.9-54.73s, 0.83s) is a very short hand-transition whose released item is not clearly resolved. Steps 18 (0.3s) and 19 are short/compound transit-and-place segments while moving to the microwave; boundary_note documents the compound actions rather than altering the human-cut boundaries. Fine track ends 0.36s before ffprobe_duration (261.934s); the gap is a static shot of the finished pudding bowl at the counter, well under the 1s threshold for a tail note.
